name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, TLS and security headers, and host-level protections.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configuring Redis authentication, its PID and log directories, selected configuration overrides, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI application from Git, creates its virtual environment and database credentials, and runs Uvicorn as a systemd service.
